bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
test "$(realpath "$root")" = /home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot || exit 71
git -C "$root" fetch --no-tags origin refs/heads/chat/bug-report-userbot-20261115
test "$(git -C "$root" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = 80f98bcb8d019586d428bc9b91b3c2cba1fa81d4 || exit 72
stage="$root/.worktrees/shared-client-compat-80f98bc"
test ! -e "$stage" || exit 73
mkdir -p "$root/.worktrees"
git -C "$root" worktree add --detach "$stage" FETCH_HEAD || exit 74
test "$(git -C "$stage" rev-parse HEAD)" = 80f98bcb8d019586d428bc9b91b3c2cba1fa81d4 || exit 75
docker build --network=host --pull=false -f "$stage/artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs" -t gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:clientcompat-80f98bc "$stage" || exit 76
docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:clientcompat-80f98bc >/dev/null || exit 77
printf 'CLIENT_COMPAT_STAGE_PASS\n'
